meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把杂乱难懂的代码拆解重组成清晰结构,让它更易读易改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有写乱或过时的代码想理清结构又不想改变行为
copy.tagline_en: Break messy code into a clearer structure without changing what it does
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your code feels tangled and you want cleaner structure without behavior changes

howto.what: 发出 /refactor 后，它会先澄清重构目标，再探索代码库、梳理依赖与影响区、评估测试覆盖并写出分步计划；每改一步都跑测试和类型检查，最后做整体回归验证。
howto.when: 当你要求重构、简化、抽取代码等时触发；也可直接输入 /refactor 并附上目标和 --scope/--strategy 参数。

say.note: 先探索代码再给出重构计划

say.text: 把 AuthService 的校验逻辑抽成独立模块
say.note: 会先确认目标再分步改

howto.what_en: After you run /refactor, it clarifies the goal, explores the codebase, maps dependencies and impact zones, checks test coverage, and writes a step-by-step plan. It runs tests and type checks after each step, then a final regression check.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to refactor, simplify, or extract code, etc. You can also type /refactor with a target plus --scope or --strategy.

say_en.note: Explores first, then plans the refactor

say_en.text: Extract AuthService validation into its own module
say_en.note: Clarifies the goal before making changes
